author: Program Office
title: Your day at a glance
items: Breakfast is in the dorm lounge this morning; lunch and dinner are at the normal times.
9:00 rehearsal, 4:30 masterclass — full schedule is on the Schedule tab.
Tomorrow's final concert: your dress-rehearsal time is posted under Schedule → Saturday.

author: Program Office
title: Final concert — what to do tomorrow
body: Arrive at your dress-rehearsal time (Schedule → Saturday). Sign in at the desk outside the hall before you go backstage. Only performers in the hall; a CA will tell you when to enter.

author: Program Office
body: It's raining today — bring a cover for your instrument on the walk to the hall.

author: Residence Life
body: Practice rooms are first-come, first-serve. Once you're in one, stay put, and follow the 50/10 rule — 50 minutes on, 10 minutes off.

author: Residence Life
body: Lights-out is 10:00 tonight if this morning's rehearsal goes well, 9:30 if we need the extra rest before the concert.

author: CA Team
body: Head to the cafeteria for lunch — a CA is there waiting for you.

author: CA Team
body: Have your phone on you for the 9:00 pm check-in tonight.

author: Program Office
body: Flying home Sunday? Check in for your flight as soon as it opens, then add your details under Sign-ups → Airport shuttle. A CA can help if you're stuck.

author: Chamber Coordinator
body: One quartet is missing its second-violin part (blue folder). Please check your bag and drop it at the front desk if you find it.

author: Dining
body: Turn in your meal card at the front desk before you leave at the end of the week.
